description: This file declares the ApplicationManagementServer class, which implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface for IPC-based application management in the Rialto server. It includes class declarations, constructor, destructor, and methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and handling client disconnections, as well as private members for IPC server components.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: Implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface for managing application sessions via IPC, including server initialization, event handling, and client disconnection management.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server with factory objects and session manager reference.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a session state change event to clients.

methods.name: onClientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a client disconnects.
